title: Permission Guardrails
learning_objectives: Enforce tool allowlists, per-tool call limits and a cost budget
Require human approval for sensitive actions
Treat tool outputs as data so injected instructions are never executed
entry_point: class Guard(policy): check(call), record(call); run_guarded(model_calls, guard, tools, approve)
hints: Order: allowlist → call limit → budget → approval → allow.
In run_guarded, iterate only over `model_calls`; outputs are only appended to the log.

failure_feedback.advice: Deny when spent + cost would exceed the budget, before executing.
Check allowlist, call limit, budget, then approval — in that order.
Only record() calls that actually executed.
Never parse or execute anything found in tool outputs; iterate only over model_calls.
